name: Wynnewood Village
summary: Wynnewood Village is an outdoor shopping plaza in Dallas featuring major grocery anchors Kroger and El Rancho Supermercado, along with clothing and electronics retailers. This community-focused center serves the diverse Oak Cliff neighborhood with convenient access to everyday shopping needs.
demographics: Wynnewood Village serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in the Oak Cliff area of Dallas, with a significant Hispanic population reflected by the presence of El Rancho Supermercado. The trade area attracts families and working professionals seeking convenient grocery shopping and everyday retail needs, with household incomes ranging from lower-middle to middle class. Primary shoppers include budget-conscious consumers who value accessibility and ethnic food options, with strong weekday traffic from local residents and workers in the surrounding neighborhoods.
description: Wynnewood Village is a well-established outdoor shopping plaza located in the Oak Cliff neighborhood of Dallas, Texas, serving as a vital community retail hub since its development. The center features a diverse mix of tenants anchored by major grocery stores including Kroger and El Rancho Supermercado, catering to the area's multicultural population with both mainstream and specialty food offerings. Beyond groceries, shoppers will find a practical selection of clothing retailers and electronics stores that meet everyday shopping needs. The open-air plaza design provides convenient access with ample parking, making it easy for families and busy professionals to complete their errands efficiently. With a strong 4.1-star rating from nearly 6,000 reviews, Wynnewood Village has earned its reputation as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination that combines convenience, variety, and accessibility for the diverse Oak Cliff community.
